mgon po 'od dpag med kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs/hrīḥnub phyogs bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas/ /thog ma'i ston pa mgon po 'od mi 'gyur/ /long

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250mgon po 'od dpag med kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs/1$0000300 hrīḥ nub phyogs bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas// thog ma'i ston pa mgon po 'od mi 'gyur// longs spyod rdzogs pa bcom ldan tshe dpag med// thugs rje sprul sku 'od dpag med pa'i tshul// sku gsum ston pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs// snying rje'i mnga' bdag 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang*// rgyal sras thu bo mthu chen rdo rje 'dzin// gsang chen mdzod 'dzin yum chen tsaṇ+ḍa lī// rgyal ba'i phrin las gsum la gsol ba 'debs// rdzus skyes sprul sku 'chi med pad+ma 'byung*// rgyal yum mtsho rgyal thugs sras sa le 'od// 'khor lo'i mgon po nus ldan chos kyi rje// brgyud bcas bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bskal bzang rgyal ba'i gtso bo 'od dpag med// pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po ltar 'bar sku /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag lhung bzed 'dzin// mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar la gsol ba 'debs// le brgan dar ni li khri'i mdangs 'dzin pa'i// chos gos rnam gsum zlum por bgos pas bklubs// dri med pad+ma stong ldan zla dkyil dbus// g.yo med skyil krung bzhugs la gsol ba 'debs// sems dpa' chen po brgyad dang sems ma brgyad// sgo ma bzhi dang tshangs spyod thub pa drug /kun kyang mnyen lcug 'khril ldem zhi ba'i chas// rgyan dang phyag rgya rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs// rin chen sna tshogs khang brtsegs khrus kyi rdzing*// dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'byung gter bum dang*// sprul pa'i bya tshogs chos kyi sgra snyan can// bsam yas zhing gi bkod par gsol ba 'debs// mgon po khyod kyi zhing dang sku'i bkod pa'i// nyams 'gyur yid la ri mor bris byas te// gang gi yon tan dran pas gsol 'debs na// dus min 'chi sogs rkyen ngan zhi ba dang*// ring po'i tshe dang dpal 'byor phun tshogs ldan// phyi ma dag pa'i zhing mchog bla med der// pad+ma'i sbubs nas don gnyis lhun grub shog

ces pa mgon po 'od dpag med kyi brgyud 'debs 'di yang bla ma nā tha dzñā nas g.yu drug dkar chung legs lha rdzas kyi dar dang bcas nas bskul ngor 'dzam gling rda ོ rjes spel ba'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
